a: बैंबिकः — A man who is assiduous in his attentions to ladies, a gallant, lover; दाक्षिण्यं नाम बिंबोष्ठि बैंबिकानां कुलव्रतं M. 4. 14.

m: बैदापुटायन m. patr. fr. बिदा-पुट, g. अश्वादि, Kāś.
बैदायन m. patr. fr. बिद, g. अश्वादि.
1. बैद m. (also वैद) patr. fr. बिद, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr. (f(ई). , Pat.)
2. बैद mfn. (fr. 1. बैद), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 127, Sch.
बैद m. a partic. Try-aha, KātyŚr.
बैद—कुल n. (prob.) the family of the Baidas, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 64, Vārtt., Pat.
बैदल See वैदल.
बैद—त्रि-रात्र m. a partic. Tri-rātra, ŚrS.
बैदि m. id., Pāṇ. iv, 1, 104, Sch.
बैहीनरि m. (also written वैह्˚) patr. fr. बहीनर, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 1, Vārtt. 6, Pat., (others fr. विह्˚)
N. of a chamberlain, Mudr.
बै˚जीय mfn. (fr. बैजि) g. गहादि.
बैजल-देव m. N. of a prince and author, ib. (cf. बीजल under बीज).
बैजनाथ m. (prob. patr. fr. बीजनाथ) N. of an author, Cat.
बैजवापायन m. patr. fr. prec. ib.
N. of an author, Cat.
बैजवा˚पीय mfn. (fr. prec.) g. रैवतिकादि
बैजवा˚पीय m. a prince of the Baijavāpis g. दामन्य्-आदि.
बैजवाप m. (also written वैज्˚) patr. fr. बिजवाप, ŚBr.
बैजवाप—गृह्य n. N. of wk.
बैजवाप—स्मृति f. N. of wk.
बैजवापि m. patr. fr. बीज-वाप or ˚पिन्, MaitrS.; Car. (cf. g. रैवतिकादि)
pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि.
बै˚जेय m. patr. fr. बीज, g. शुभ्रादि.
बैजि (fr. बीज) g. गहादि (Kāś., वैदजि).
बैजिक mfn. (fr. बीज) relating to seed, seminal, paternal (opp. to गार्भिक, relating to the womb, maternal), Mn. ii, 27
sexual, v, 63
belonging to any primary cause or source or principle, original, MW.
बैजिक m. a young shoot, sprout, L.
बैजिक n. oil prepared from Moringa Pterygosperma, L.
cause, source, L.
the spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit, L.
a: बैजिक — a. (की f.) [बीजेन निवृर्त्तं ठक्] 1 Seminal. --2 Original. --3 Relating to conception. --4 Relating to sexual union. --कः A sprout, young shoot. --कं 1 Cause, source, origin. --2 The spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit. --3 Oil of the शिग्रु plants.

m: बैकि m. patr. g. तौल्वल्य्-आदि, Kāś.
बैलायन mfn. g. पक्षादि.
बैल mf(ई)n. (fr. बिल, also written वैल, q.v.) living in holes (m. an animal l˚ in h˚), Car.
relating, to or derived from animals living in h˚, MBh.
बैल्म-वेग-रुद्र m. pl. N. of a partic. class of Śaiva ascetics, Kāraṇḍ.
बैल्वायन m. patr. fr. बैल्व, g. अश्वादि.
बैल्व mf(ई)n. (fr. बिल्व) relating to or coming from the Bilva tree, made of Bilva wood, ŚBr. &c. &c.
covered with B˚ trees, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 67, Sch.
बैल्व m. N. of a man g. अश्वादि
बैल्व n. the fruit of the B˚ tree, L.
a: बैल्व — a. (ल्वी f.) [बिल्वस्येदं अण्] 1 Relating to or made of the Bilva tree or its wood. --2 Covered with Bilva trees. --ल्वं The fruit of the Bilva tree.

m: बैल्वज (fr. बिल्व-ज) g. राजन्यादि (v.l. बैल्वल)
बैल्व˚जक mfn. (with देश) inhabited by Bailvajas, ib.
बैल्व˚कीय mfn. (fr. prec.), Pat.
बैल्वक mfn. g. अरीहणादि.
बैल्वल g. राजन्यादि, Kāś.
बैल्व˚लक mfn. inhabited by Bailvalas, ib.
बैल्व—मय mf(ई)n., Pāṇ. iv, 3, 155, Sch.
बैल्ववन m. (prob.) an inhabitant of Bilvavana or a wood of Bilva trees g. राजन्यादि.
बैल्वव˚नक mfn. (with देश) inhabited by Bailvavanas, ib.
बैल्वयत m. patr. g. क्रौड्य्-आदि (f. ˚त्या, ib.)
बैल्यायन m. patr. fr. बैल्य, ib.
बैल्य mfn. N. of a man g. अश्वादि (v.l. for बैल्व).
बैम्बकि m. (also written वै˚) patr. fr. बिम्ब, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 97, Vārtt., Pat.
बैन्द m. N. of a degraded tribe, VS. (= निषाध, Mahīdh.)
बैन्द˚वीय m. a prince of the Baindavis, ib.
बैन्दव m. (also written वै˚) patr. fr. बिन्दु, g. बिदादि.
बैन्दवि m. pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि.
बैडाल mf(ई)n. (fr. बिडाल) belonging to a cat, peculiar to cats, feline, MBh.
a: बैडाल — a. (ली f.) [बिडालस्येदं अण्] 1 Relating to a cat. --2 Peculiar to cats. --Comp. --व्रतं ‘a cat-like observance,’ concealing one's malice or evil designs under the garb of piety or virtue. --व्रतिः one who leads a chaste life simply from want of female company (and not because he has controlled his senses). --व्रतिकः, --व्रतिन् m. a religious hypocrite, an impostor.

m: बैडाल—व्रत n. ‘cat-like observance’, putting on a show of virtue or piety to conceal malice and evil designs, MW.
बैडाल—व्रति m. one who leads a chaste or continent life merely from the absence of women or temptation, L.
बैडाल—व्रतिक (Mn.; Kāv.; Pur.) mfn. acting like a cat, hypocritical, a religious impostor (= भण्ड-तपस्विन्).
बैडाल—व्रतिन् (Pur.) mfn. acting like a cat, hypocritical, a religious impostor (= भण्ड-तपस्विन्).
बैडालि-कर्णक-कन्थ and बैडालि-कर्णि-कन्थ, n. (prob.) N. of a city g. चिहणादि.
बैट्-संख्या (?) f. a kind of Anukramaṇī to the three Vedas, Cat.
बैष्क n. (prob. cf. वेष्क, ब्लेष्क, मेष्क), flesh from an animal killed by a beast of prey or in a trap, Gaut.
